## Basic Input Components

### CmrButton

A styled button component built on Material-UI's Button with text transform disabled by default.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/CmrButton/CmrButton.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CmrButton = (props: ButtonProps) => JSX.Element
```

**Props:** Extends all Material-UI `ButtonProps`
- `children`: React.ReactNode - Button content
- `onClick`: () => void - Click handler
- `variant`: 'text' | 'outlined' | 'contained' - Button style
- `color`: 'inherit' | 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning'
- `style`: CSSProperties - Additional inline styles
- ...all other Material-UI Button props

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrButton from './CmrComponents/CmrButton';

<CmrButton
  variant="outlined"
  sx={{color:'#1976d2'}}
  onClick={() => console.log('clicked')}
>
  Click Me
</CmrButton>
```

### CmrCheckbox

A checkbox component with integrated label support using Material-UI.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/CmrCheckbox/CmrCheckbox.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
export const CmrCheckbox = (props: CmrCheckboxProps) => JSX.Element

interface CmrCheckboxProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    checked?: boolean;
    defaultChecked?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    indeterminate?: boolean;
    onChange?: (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    children?: any;
    style?: any;
}
```

**Props:**
- `checked`: boolean - Controlled checked state
- `defaultChecked`: boolean - Default checked state (uncontrolled)
- `disabled`: boolean - Whether checkbox is disabled
- `onChange`: (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void - Change event handler
- `children`: React.ReactNode - Label content
- `style`: CSSProperties - Inline styles
- `className`: string - CSS class name

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import { CmrCheckbox } from './CmrComponents/CmrCheckbox';

<CmrCheckbox
  defaultChecked={true}
  onChange={(e) => {
    console.log('Checked:', e.target.checked);
  }}
>
  Enable Feature
</CmrCheckbox>
```

### CmrInput

A text input component built on Ant Design's Input with custom styling.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/CmrInput/CmrInput.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
export const CmrInput = (props: CmrInputProps) => JSX.Element

interface CmrInputProps extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'size' | 'prefix' | 'type'> {
    defaultValue?: string;
    id?: string;
    maxLength?: number;
    size?: SizeType; // 'small' | 'middle' | 'large'
    value?: string;
    type?: any;
    prefix?: React.ReactNode;
    bordered?: boolean;
    onChange?: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    onPressEnter?: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
}
```

**Props:**
- `value`: string - Controlled input value
- `defaultValue`: string - Default value (uncontrolled)
- `type`: string - Input type (text, password, email, etc.)
- `onChange`: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void - Change handler
- `onPressEnter`: (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void - Enter key handler
- `prefix`: React.ReactNode - Prefix icon or element
- `maxLength`: number - Maximum character length
- `size`: 'small' | 'middle' | 'large' - Input size
- `bordered`: boolean - Whether to show border

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import { CmrInput } from './CmrComponents/CmrInput';

<CmrInput
  placeholder="Enter your name"
  value={name}
  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
  onPressEnter={() => handleSubmit()}
  maxLength={50}
/>
```

### CmrSelect

A dropdown select component built with react-select, featuring custom styling and Material-UI integration.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/CmrSelect/CmrSelect.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CmrSelect: React.FC<CmrSelectProps> = (props) => JSX.Element

export interface Option {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface CmrSelectProps {
  options: Option[];
  disabled?: boolean;
  value?: string; // Controlled
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  defaultValue?: string; // Uncontrolled
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  sx?: any; // Material-UI style object
  className?: string;
  SelectProps?: Record<string, any>;
}
```

**Props:**
- `options`: Option[] - Array of select options with label, value, and optional disabled flag
- `value`: string - Controlled selected value
- `defaultValue`: string - Default selected value (uncontrolled)
- `onChange`: (value: string) => void - Selection change handler
- `disabled`: boolean - Whether select is disabled
- `fullWidth`: boolean - Whether select takes full width
- `sx`: object - Material-UI style object
- `className`: string - CSS class name

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrSelect from './CmrComponents/CmrSelect';

const options = [
  { label: 'Option 1', value: '1' },
  { label: 'Option 2', value: '2' },
  { label: 'Option 3', value: '3', disabled: true }
];

<CmrSelect
  options={options}
  defaultValue="1"
  onChange={(value) => console.log('Selected:', value)}
  fullWidth
/>
```

## Slider Components

### Slider

A custom slider component with draggable handle and editable numeric input, supporting value transformations.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/gui-slider/Slider.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
export const Slider = (props: {
    name: string,
    min: number,
    max: number,
    setValue?: (value: number) => void,
    transform?: (x: number) => number,
    inverse?: (x: number) => number,
    value?: number
}) => JSX.Element
```

**Props:**
- `name`: string - Label displayed next to the slider
- `min`: number - Minimum value
- `max`: number - Maximum value
- `value`: number - Current value (controlled)
- `setValue`: (value: number) => void - Value change handler
- `transform`: (x: number) => number - Function to transform displayed value (default: identity)
- `inverse`: (x: number) => number - Inverse transformation for input (default: identity)

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import { Slider } from './CmrComponents/gui-slider/Slider';

<Slider
  name="Opacity"
  min={0}
  max={1}
  value={opacity}
  setValue={(val) => setOpacity(val)}
/>

// With logarithmic scale
<Slider
  name="Frequency"
  min={1}
  max={1000}
  value={freq}
  setValue={setFreq}
  transform={(x) => Math.log10(x)}
  inverse={(y) => Math.pow(10, y)}
/>
```

### TKDualRange

A modern dual-range slider component with transformation support, designed for window/level adjustments in medical imaging.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/tk-dualrange/TKDualRange.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
export default function TKDualRange(props: {
  name?: string;
  minDomain: number; // Min possible value in real space
  maxDomain: number; // Max possible value in real space
  valueLow: number; // Current low value in real space
  valueHigh: number; // Current high value in real space
  onChangeLow: (v: number) => void; // Callback with real value
  onChangeHigh: (v: number) => void; // Callback with real value
  transform?: (x: number) => number; // real -> render space
  inverse?: (y: number) => number; // render -> real space
  step?: number; // Step in render space
  precision?: number; // Display precision for inputs
  accentColor?: string; // Slider color
}) => JSX.Element
```

**Props:**
- `name`: string - Label for the slider (default: "Values")
- `minDomain`: number - Minimum possible value in real space
- `maxDomain`: number - Maximum possible value in real space
- `valueLow`: number - Current low value in real space
- `valueHigh`: number - Current high value in real space
- `onChangeLow`: (v: number) => void - Handler for low value changes (receives real value)
- `onChangeHigh`: (v: number) => void - Handler for high value changes (receives real value)
- `transform`: (x: number) => number - Transform real values to render space (default: identity)
- `inverse`: (y: number) => number - Transform render values to real space (default: identity)
- `step`: number - Step size in render space
- `precision`: number - Number of decimal places for display (default: 3)
- `accentColor`: string - Color for the range fill (default: '#580f8b')

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import TKDualRange from './CmrComponents/tk-dualrange/TKDualRange';

// Basic usage
<TKDualRange
  name="Intensity Range"
  minDomain={0}
  maxDomain={255}
  valueLow={low}
  valueHigh={high}
  onChangeLow={setLow}
  onChangeHigh={setHigh}
/>

// With logarithmic transformation
<TKDualRange
  name="Log Range"
  minDomain={1}
  maxDomain={10000}
  valueLow={lowVal}
  valueHigh={highVal}
  onChangeLow={setLowVal}
  onChangeHigh={setHighVal}
  transform={(x) => Math.log10(x)}
  inverse={(y) => Math.pow(10, y)}
  precision={2}
  accentColor="#FF5733"
/>
```

## File Upload Components

### CmrUpload

A comprehensive file upload component with drag-and-drop support, progress tracking, and customizable upload handlers.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/upload/Upload.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CmrUpload = (props: CMRUploadProps) => JSX.Element

export interface LambdaFile {
    filename: string;
    filetype: string;
    filesize: string;
    filemd5: string;
    file: File;
}

interface CMRUploadProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
    retains?: boolean;
    maxCount: number;
    changeNameAfterUpload?: boolean;
    onRemove?: (removedFile: File) => void;
    beforeUpload?: (file: File) => Promise<boolean>;
    createPayload?: (file: File, fileAlias: string, fileDatabase: string) =>
        Promise<{ destination: string, lambdaFile: LambdaFile, file: File, config: AxiosRequestConfig } | undefined>;
    onUploadProgressUpdate?: (loaded: number, total: number) => void | undefined;
    onUploaded: (res: AxiosResponse, file: File) => Promise<void> | void;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme> | undefined;
    fileExtension?: string | string[];
    uploadStarted?: () => void;
    uploadEnded?: () => void;
    uploadFailed?: () => void;
    uploadProgressed?: (progress: number) => void;
    uploadHandler?: (file: File, fileAlias: string, fileDatabase: string,
        onProgress?: (progress: number) => void,
        onUploaded?: (res: AxiosResponse, file: File) => void) => Promise<number>;
    fullWidth?: boolean;
    style?: any;
    reusable?: boolean;
    uploadButtonName?: string;
    preprocess?: (file: File) => Promise<File | undefined | number>;
    color?: "inherit" | "primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning";
}
```

**Props:**
- `maxCount`: number - Maximum number of files allowed
- `onUploaded`: (res: AxiosResponse, file: File) => void - Callback when upload succeeds
- `uploadHandler`: function - Custom upload handler (overrides default behavior)
- `createPayload`: function - Creates the upload payload (used if uploadHandler not provided)
- `beforeUpload`: (file: File) => Promise<boolean> - Pre-upload validation
- `preprocess`: (file: File) => Promise<File | undefined | number> - Process file before upload
- `fileExtension`: string | string[] - Accepted file extensions
- `uploadStarted`: () => void - Callback when upload starts
- `uploadEnded`: () => void - Callback when upload ends
- `uploadFailed`: () => void - Callback when upload fails
- `uploadProgressed`: (progress: number) => void - Progress update callback
- `uploadButtonName`: string - Custom button text
- `reusable`: boolean - Whether button reverts after upload
- `fullWidth`: boolean - Whether button takes full width
- `color`: Material-UI button color

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrUpload from './CmrComponents/upload/Upload';

<CmrUpload
  maxCount={1}
  fileExtension={['.nii', '.nii.gz']}
  uploadButtonName="Upload Scan"
  fullWidth
  color="primary"
  beforeUpload={async (file) => {
    if (file.size > 100000000) {
      alert('File too large');
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }}
  uploadHandler={async (file, alias, db, onProgress, onUploaded) => {
    // Custom upload logic
    return 200; // HTTP status code
  }}
  onUploaded={(res, file) => {
    console.log('Upload complete:', file.name);
  }}
  uploadProgressed={(progress) => {
    console.log(`Upload progress: ${progress}%`);
  }}
/>
```

### CmrSelectUpload

A combined component that allows selecting from previously uploaded files or uploading a new file.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/select-upload/SelectUpload.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CMRSelectUpload = (props: CMRSelectUploadProps) => JSX.Element

interface UploadedFile {
    id: number;
    fileName: string;
    link: string;
    md5?: string;
    size: string;
    status: string;
    createdAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    database: string;
    location: string;
}

interface CMRSelectUploadProps extends CMRUploadProps {
    fileSelection: UploadedFile[];
    onSelected: (file?: UploadedFile) => void;
    chosenFile?: string;
    buttonText?: string;
    selectStyles?: any;
    fileExtension?: string | string[];
}
```

**Props:**
- All props from `CMRUploadProps`, plus:
- `fileSelection`: UploadedFile[] - Array of previously uploaded files
- `onSelected`: (file?: UploadedFile) => void - Callback when a file is selected
- `chosenFile`: string - Currently chosen file name (for display)
- `buttonText`: string - Custom button text
- `selectStyles`: any - Custom styles for the select dropdown

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CMRSelectUpload from './CmrComponents/select-upload/SelectUpload';

<CMRSelectUpload
  fileSelection={uploadedFiles}
  onSelected={(file) => {
    if (file) {
      console.log('Selected file:', file.fileName);
      setSelectedFile(file);
    }
  }}
  chosenFile={selectedFile?.fileName}
  buttonText="Choose File"
  fileExtension=".nii"
  maxCount={1}
  uploadHandler={customUploadHandler}
  onUploaded={(res, file) => {
    // Refresh file list
    fetchUploadedFiles();
  }}
/>
```

## Dialog Components

### CmrConfirmation

A confirmation dialog with customizable message, buttons, and callbacks.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/dialogue/Confirmation.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
export default function CmrConfirmation(props: {
    name: string | undefined;
    message: string | undefined;
    cancelText?: string;
    confirmText?: string;
    color?: "inherit" | "primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning";
    open: boolean;
    setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
    confirmCallback?: () => void;
    cancelCallback?: () => void;
    cancellable?: boolean;
    width?: number;
    extraButtons?: ExtraButton[];
}) => JSX.Element

type ExtraButton = {
    text: string;
    color?: "inherit" | "primary" | "secondary" | "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning";
    onClick: () => void;
};
```

**Props:**
- `name`: string - Dialog title
- `message`: string - Dialog message content
- `open`: boolean - Whether dialog is open
- `setOpen`: (open: boolean) => void - Function to control dialog state
- `confirmCallback`: () => void - Called when confirm button is clicked
- `cancelCallback`: () => void - Called when cancel button is clicked
- `confirmText`: string - Text for confirm button (default: 'Confirm')
- `cancelText`: string - Text for cancel button (default: 'Cancel')
- `cancellable`: boolean - Whether to show cancel button (default: false)
- `color`: Material-UI color - Color for confirm button
- `width`: number - Dialog width
- `extraButtons`: ExtraButton[] - Additional custom buttons

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrConfirmation from './CmrComponents/dialogue/Confirmation';

const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<CmrConfirmation
  name="Delete File"
  message="Are you sure you want to delete this file? This action cannot be undone."
  open={open}
  setOpen={setOpen}
  confirmText="Delete"
  cancelText="Cancel"
  color="error"
  cancellable={true}
  confirmCallback={() => {
    deleteFile();
  }}
  cancelCallback={() => {
    console.log('Cancelled');
  }}
  extraButtons={[
    {
      text: 'Archive Instead',
      color: 'warning',
      onClick: () => archiveFile()
    }
  ]}
/>
```

- `message`: string - Dialog message
- `defaultText`: string - Default text in the input field
- `suffix`: string - Text appended to the input value
- `open`: boolean - Whether dialog is open
- `setOpen`: (open: boolean) => void - Function to control dialog state
- `confirmCallback`: (text: string) => void - Called with edited text on confirm
- `cancelCallback`: (text: string) => void - Called with edited text on cancel
- `cancellable`: boolean - Whether to show cancel button
- `color`: Material-UI color - Color for confirm button

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrEditConfirmation from './CmrComponents/dialogue/EditConfirmation';

const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<CmrEditConfirmation
  name="Set Threshold"
  message="Enter a threshold value:"
  defaultText="50"
  suffix=" ms"
  open={open}
  setOpen={setOpen}
  cancellable={true}
  confirmCallback={(text) => {
    console.log('New value:', text); // Includes suffix
    setThreshold(text);
  }}
/>
```

---

### CmrNameDialog

A dialog for renaming files with extension validation.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/rename/edit.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
export default function CmrNameDialog(props: {
    originalName: string;
    renamingCallback: (alias: string) => Promise<boolean>,
    open: boolean,
    setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
}) => JSX.Element
```

**Props:**
- `originalName`: string - The current file name
- `renamingCallback`: (alias: string) => Promise<boolean> - Async callback for renaming (returns success)
- `open`: boolean - Whether dialog is open
- `setOpen`: (open: boolean) => void - Function to control dialog state

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrNameDialog from './CmrComponents/rename/edit';

const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<CmrNameDialog
  originalName="scan.nii"
  open={open}
  setOpen={setOpen}
  renamingCallback={async (newName) => {
    try {
      await renameFile(newName);
      return true; // Success
    } catch (error) {
      alert('Rename failed');
      return false; // Failure
    }
  }}
/>
```

## Layout Components

### CmrPanel

A collapsible panel component with header and expandable content area.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/panel/Panel.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CmrPanel = (props: CmrPanelProps) => JSX.Element

interface CmrPanelProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
    activeKey?: string | string[];
    header: string | undefined;
    children: ReactNode;
    panelKey?: number;
    onToggle?: (key: number | undefined) => void;
    expanded?: boolean;
    cardProps?: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;
}
```

**Props:**
- `header`: string - Panel header text (hidden if undefined)
- `children`: React.ReactNode - Panel content
- `expanded`: boolean - Whether panel is expanded
- `onToggle`: (key: number | undefined) => void - Toggle handler
- `panelKey`: number - Unique key for the panel
- `cardProps`: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> - Props for the card body
- `className`: string - CSS class for the card

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrPanel from './CmrComponents/panel/Panel';

const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

<CmrPanel
  header="Settings"
  expanded={expanded}
  onToggle={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
  className="my-panel"
>
  <div>Panel content goes here</div>
</CmrPanel>
```

---

### CmrCollapse

A collapse container that manages multiple collapsible panels.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/collapse/Collapse.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CmrCollapse = (props: CmrCollapseProps) => JSX.Element

interface CmrCollapseProps {
    accordion?: boolean;
    activeKey?: Array<string | number> | number;
    bordered?: boolean;
    collapsible?: CollapsibleType;
    defaultActiveKey?: Array<string | number>;
    destroyInactivePanel?: boolean;
    expandIconPosition?: ExpandIconPosition;
    ghost?: boolean;
    onChange?: (key: Array<string | number> | number) => void;
    children?: JSX.Element[] | JSX.Element; // CmrPanel components
}
```

**Props:**
- `children`: JSX.Element | JSX.Element[] - CmrPanel components to manage
- `activeKey`: Array<string | number> | number - Controlled active panel keys
- `defaultActiveKey`: Array<string | number> - Default active panel keys
- `onChange`: (key: Array<string | number> | number) => void - Called when panels expand/collapse
- `accordion`: boolean - Whether to use accordion mode (only one panel open)

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrCollapse from './CmrComponents/collapse/Collapse';
import CmrPanel from './CmrComponents/panel/Panel';

<CmrCollapse defaultActiveKey={[0, 1]} onChange={(keys) => console.log(keys)}>
  <CmrPanel header="Panel 1">
    <div>Content 1</div>
  </CmrPanel>
  <CmrPanel header="Panel 2">
    <div>Content 2</div>
  </CmrPanel>
  <CmrPanel header="Panel 3">
    <div>Content 3</div>
  </CmrPanel>
</CmrCollapse>
```

### CmrTooltip

A tooltip component built on Ant Design's Tooltip.

**Location:** `src/CmrComponents/tooltip/Tooltip.tsx`

**Type Signature:**
```typescript
const CmrTooltip = (props: CmrTooltipProps) => JSX.Element

interface CmrTooltipProps {
    arrowPointAtCenter?: boolean;
    autoAdjustOverflow?: boolean;
    color?: string;
    defaultVisible?: boolean;
    mouseEnterDelay?: number;
    mouseLeaveDelay?: number;
    overlayClassName?: string;
    placement?: TooltipPlacement; // 'top' | 'left' | 'right' | 'bottom' | ...
    visible?: boolean;
    title: React.ReactNode; // Tooltip content
    overlay?: React.ReactNode;
}
```

**Props:**
- `title`: React.ReactNode - Tooltip content
- `placement`: TooltipPlacement - Position of the tooltip
- `visible`: boolean - Controlled visibility
- `defaultVisible`: boolean - Default visibility
- `mouseEnterDelay`: number - Delay in ms before showing
- `mouseLeaveDelay`: number - Delay in ms before hiding
- `color`: string - Background color
- `arrowPointAtCenter`: boolean - Whether arrow points to center

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
import CmrTooltip from './CmrComponents/tooltip/Tooltip';

<CmrTooltip
  title="This is helpful information"
  placement="top"
  mouseEnterDelay={500}
>
  <button>Hover me</button>
</CmrTooltip>
```

## Import Patterns

All components can be imported from the `cloudmr-ux` package (when published) or directly from their file paths:

```typescript
// From package (recommended for production)
import { CmrButton, CmrCheckbox, CmrInput } from 'cloudmr-ux';

// Direct import from file path (for development)
import CmrButton from './CmrComponents/CmrButton/CmrButton';
import { CmrCheckbox } from './CmrComponents/CmrCheckbox/CmrCheckbox';
```

## Component Categories

### Form Controls
- CmrButton, CmrCheckbox, CmrInput, CmrInputNumber, CmrSelect, CmrRadioGroup, CmrColorPicker

### Sliders & Range Inputs
- Slider, ControlledSlider, DualSlider, TKDualRange

### File Management
- CmrUpload, CmrUploadWindow, CmrSelectUpload

### Dialogs & Modals
- CmrConfirmation, CmrDeletionDialog, CmrEditConfirmation, CmrNameDialog

### Layout & Structure
- CmrPanel, CmrCollapse, Header

### Utilities
- CmrLabel, CmrTooltip

---

## Common Patterns

### Controlled vs Uncontrolled Components

Many components support both controlled and uncontrolled patterns:

```tsx
// Controlled
<CmrCheckbox
  checked={isChecked}
  onChange={(e) => setIsChecked(e.target.checked)}
/>

// Uncontrolled
<CmrCheckbox
  defaultChecked={true}
  onChange={(e) => console.log(e.target.checked)}
/>
```

### File Upload Pattern

```tsx
<CmrUpload
  maxCount={1}
  fileExtension=".zip"
  beforeUpload={async (file) => {
    // Validate file
    return file.size < 100000000;
  }}
  preprocess={async (file) => {
    // Process file
    return processedFile;
  }}
  uploadHandler={customUploadHandler}
  onUploaded={(res, file) => {
    // Handle success
  }}
  uploadFailed={() => {
    // Handle failure
  }}
/>
```

### Dialog Pattern

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<>
  <button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open Dialog</button>

  <CmrConfirmation
    name="Confirm Action"
    message="Are you sure?"
    open={open}
    setOpen={setOpen}
    confirmCallback={() => performAction()}
    cancellable={true}
  />
</>
```

---

## Styling

Components use a combination of:
- Material-UI's `sx` prop for styling
- Inline `style` prop
- CSS classes via `className` prop
- Custom CSS files for specific components

Example:
```tsx
<CmrButton
  sx={{ margin: 2, padding: 1 }}
  style={{ textTransform: 'uppercase' }}
  className="custom-button"
>
  Styled Button
</CmrButton>
```
